PokeWallClash asset sources

Roster sprites (#001-151):
https://github.com/PokeAPI/sprites
Generation V Black/White front sprites. Character art belongs to Nintendo,
Game Freak and The Pokemon Company.

Battle stats, damage, abilities and evolution levels are tower defense
adaptations rather than main-series battle rules. Battlefield artwork is
drawn locally by the game. This is an unofficial, noncommercial fan project.

Directional battlefield animation sheets:
https://github.com/PMDCollab/SpriteCollab
Adapted from Pokemon Arena's packaged sheets and metadata.
Original Pokemon Mystery Dungeon artwork: CHUNSOFT. Community contributions:
CC BY-NC 4.0. The original license, artist index, name mappings and per-species
histories are retained in assets/directional/. Active battlefield animation
metadata covers 29 species. Frames, pixels, timing, ground anchors and head
offsets are retained.
